name: Tales of Onyx
source:
The story is centered around the main protagonist, Eric, who grew up only to struggle The God of Creation, Onyx, created the universe and fell in love with the planet he discovered among the stars. For someone as benevolent as Onyx, there will always be someone who is malevolent as well. The God of Destruction, Opal, became envious of Onyx's fondness with his precious star system out of all other star systems across the cosmos.

In hopes of preventing Opal's methodical attacks, Onyx created the Trio of Guardians to restore the balance and order of the universe. Of course, Opal always find the way to cause chaos upon the planet. Beneath the Trio of Guardians, he created countless of minor Guardians to repel Opal's manipulation toward civilizations of the planet. Despite their efforts against Opal, the Trio of Guardians were forced to disappear for centuries until then..

You set out on a path to the future of your strange planet despite having no memories and anxiety attacks. Your own choices will hang in balance of life and death. Rebuild your bonds with everyone that surrounds you in order to grow stronger, and they will too. Only you can save the world, or lead them to their demise.

Keep in mind, there will be many routes for you to choose, especially the romantic routes. You will get to choose- to be with your destined loved one, or one of many husbandos to travel with you in order to accomplish the prophecy!

[From [url=https://txonyx.itch.io/tonyx]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕主角埃里克展开，他长大后只是为了与创世之神奥尼克斯抗争，创造了宇宙，并爱上了他在群星中发现的星球。对于像玛瑙这样仁慈的人来说，总会有一些人怀有恶意。毁灭之神欧泊嫉妒玛瑙对宇宙中所有其他星系中珍贵的星系的喜爱。

为了阻止蛋白石有条不紊的攻击，玛瑙创造了守护者三人组来恢复宇宙的平衡和秩序。当然，蛋白石总能找到给地球带来混乱的方法。在守护者三人组之下，他创造了无数的小守护者来击退欧泊对星球文明的操纵。尽管他们努力对抗蛋白石，守护者三人组还是被迫消失了几个世纪，直到那时。

尽管没有记忆并且焦虑发作，你还是踏上了通往陌生星球未来的道路。你自己的选择将决定生与死的平衡。重建你与周围每个人的联系，以便变得更强大，他们也会的。只有你才能拯救世界，或者带领他们走向灭亡。

请记住，会有很多路线供你选择，尤其是浪漫路线。你将可以选择——与你命中注定的爱人在一起，或者与众多丈夫之一一起旅行，以实现预言！
